meta.homeDescription: A collector's encyclopedia for the Pokémon Trading Card Game, with Hong Kong card shops and a peer-to-peer trade board.

footer.rights: Not affiliated with Pokémon, Nintendo, Creatures, or GAME FREAK. Card images belong to their owners.
footer.p2p: Trades are peer-to-peer. Collect Scheme does not take payment.

search.cardHint: Find one card by name, or by name plus number.
search.setHint: Find an expansion by its name or set code.

home.title: Know the card before you chase it.
home.lede: Collect Scheme is a collector's catalog for the Pokémon TCG. Card search finds one card. Set search finds an expansion. Both can be English or Japanese. Hong Kong shops and a trade board sit beside it. Auctions are not open.
home.setsBody: Find an expansion by name or code, in English or Japanese.
home.encyclopediaBody: Find one card by name or number. Related cards and sets appear while you type.
home.shopsBody: Four published Hong Kong shops. Check hours before you leave.
home.tradeBody: Post a buy or a sell, then talk on the thread. No checkout.
home.auctionBody: There is no bidding and no escrow. The page is only a preview.

encyclopedia.title: Card search
encyclopedia.intro: This page finds one card. Search a name, or a name plus a number, such as Charizard 006/165 or SV2a 006. Related cards and sets appear under the box while you type.
encyclopedia.popularNote: English and Japanese together, from searches in the last two weeks.
encyclopedia.prompt: Nobody has searched in the last two weeks. After a search, the cards people look up most will show here.
encyclopedia.empty: No card matched. Try the other print, or
encyclopedia.setEmpty: No set in this language matched. Try the other print, or search a Pokémon.
encyclopedia.missingZh: Chinese name not in the overlay yet
encyclopedia.seed: This search used the curated shelf only.
encyclopedia.live: Results include the live Pokémon TCG API.
encyclopedia.cjk: Chinese names are matched on the curated shelf only.
encyclopedia.fallback: The live catalog did not respond. Showing the curated shelf.
encyclopedia.keyOn: An API key is set, so English names can search the full catalog.
encyclopedia.keyOff: No API key is set. Add POKEMONTCG_API_KEY to search beyond this shelf.
encyclopedia.noRarity: This card has no rarity on file.
encyclopedia.noSellers: Nobody is listing this card yet.
encyclopedia.official: Japanese photos on the official site
encyclopedia.tag: Tag this card on the trade board

sets.title: Set search
sets.intro: This page finds an expansion. Search a name or a code, such as SV2A, 151, or Scarlet. Choose English or Japanese. With an empty search, that print is listed by era. Prices are not listed.
sets.empty: No set matches that. Try the English name or the set code.
sets.onShelf: From this set on the shelf
sets.shelfEmpty: This set has no cards yet.

shops.title: Hong Kong card shops
shops.intro: Four shops taken from their public pages: Mong Kok, Sham Shui Po, and Causeway Bay. Hours change. Confirm before you visit.

trade.title: Trade board
trade.disclaimer: People arrange trades themselves. Collect Scheme does not take payment, hold cards, ship anything, or guarantee a deal. Meet in public and decide for yourself.
trade.empty: No posts in this view yet.
trade.noReplies: No replies yet. Messages are only for the two of you to negotiate. The site does not take payment.
trade.replyPlaceholder: Ask about condition, place, or time
trade.formTitle: Post a buy or a sell
trade.cardSearch: Pokémon name or number, such as Charizard
trade.cardEmpty: No card on the shelf matches.
trade.cardMissing: Choose a card from the encyclopedia.
trade.descriptionPlaceholder: Condition, language, where you can meet
trade.contactPlaceholder: IG, Discord, or a phone number you are willing to share
trade.nickHint: Demo only. The name stays in this browser. There is no password.

auction.title: Auctions are coming later
auction.body: This page cannot take a bid or close a lot. Collect Scheme will not hold money for you. If you want to move a card, use the trade board and talk to the other person directly.

errors.nick: Use 2–20 letters, numbers, underscores, or hyphens.
errors.card: Pick a card from the encyclopedia.
errors.description: Write a note between 10 and 500 characters.
errors.contact: Add a contact line between 2 and 80 characters.
errors.body: Write a reply between 1 and 400 characters.
errors.full: The board is full for this demo. Try again later.
errors.generic: Could not send that. Try again.

notFound.title: That page is not on the shelf
notFound.body: The card, shop, or post may have moved.
